ZOMBIE_BOX_ZOMBIE_DESC: Hides in a box right behind another zombie. Straight shots fly over the box - only low shots (Pea Bedding, Thorn Carpet), lobbed shots (catapults) and explosions hit it until the box is torn.
ZOMBIE_BALLOON_ZOMBIE_DESC: Floats over every ground plant and gnaws flying plants. Pop the balloon with anti-air spines, flying plants, wind or explosions.
ZOMBIE_SLINGSHOT_ZOMBIE_DESC: Stops to pelt flying plants within 4 tiles with stones. Ground plants are ignored until it reaches them.
HUD_GLOVE_MOVE: Glove: tap an empty tile to move, a plant to fuse
HUD_GLOVE_PICK: Glove: tap a plant to pick it up
MSG_LAYER_OCCUPIED: That layer of the tile is already used
RESULT_CAMPAIGN_DONE: You have cleared the whole campaign! Try Endless Zone and the Daily Challenge.
SETTINGS_CB_HINTS_HINT: Adds symbols to effects that are otherwise shown only by colour.
SETTINGS_DIFFICULTY_HINT: Harder difficulties add zombies and pay more coins.
SETTINGS_DRAG_HINT: Drag seed packets onto the lawn instead of tap-tap.
SETTINGS_FPS_HINT: Lower limits save battery on phones.
SETTINGS_KEYS: Keys: 1-9, 0 seeds · Q/S shovel · G/W glove · P/Esc pause · right click cancels
SETTINGS_LANGUAGE_HINT: Only English is complete in this build; other languages fall back to English.
SETTINGS_REDUCE_MOTION_HINT: Less bobbing, flashes and camera movement.
TIP_1: Tap a plant with the same seed to give it a star: more damage and health.
TIP_2: Pumpkins go OVER a plant, Pea Bedding goes UNDER it - one tile can hold three plants.
TIP_3: Flying plants like the Garlic Drone can only be hurt by Balloon and Slingshot zombies.
TIP_4: A Cardboard Box Zombie hides behind another zombie. Use low shots, catapults or bombs.
TIP_5: The glove moves a plant to another tile. Drop it on a plant to try a cross-layer graft.
TIP_6: Fusion works in either order: plant A on B or B on A gives the same hybrid.
TIP_7: Legendary plants are expensive, but one can hold a whole lane.
TIP_8: Turbo Bean speeds up every plant in its row and column.
TIP_9: Thorn Carpet hurts every zombie walking over it, including boxes.
TIP_10: Pause the battle to change settings without leaving the level.
TIP_11: Endless Zone gets harder every wave. How far can you go?
TIP_12: A new Daily Challenge with fixed seeds appears every day.
HELP_BASICS_B:
Collect [b]sun[/b] and spend it on seed packets on the left. Tap a packet, then a tile. Zombies walk in from the right; if one reaches your house in a lane without a lawn mower, you lose. The bar at the top shows wave progress and flags mark huge waves.

Use [b]speed[/b] (top right) to fast-forward and the [b]shovel[/b] (bottom right) to remove a plant.
HELP_LAYERS_B:
Every tile has four layers:
[b]v Under[/b] - ground cover such as Pea Bedding and Thorn Carpet. Shoots low and is ignored by most zombies.
[b]Main[/b] - normal plants.
[b]o Shell[/b] - armour such as Pumpkin Shell; zombies must eat it first.
[b]^ Air[/b] - flying plants such as Garlic Drone. Ground zombies cannot reach them; only Balloon and Slingshot zombies can.
HELP_GLOVE_B:
Tap the [b]glove[/b] (bottom right), then a plant to pick it up, then a destination.
- Empty tile: the plant moves there (keeps stars and health).
- Another plant: tries to fuse them, even across layers.
The glove recharges for a few seconds after every move.
HELP_FUSION_B:
Planting a seed on a matching plant of the same layer makes a [b]hybrid[/b] - the order does not matter. Plants on different layers (for example Pumpkin Shell + Bramble Vine) can only be fused with the glove. Discovered recipes appear in the Almanac.

[b]Evolve[/b]: some plants grow into a stronger form for extra sun.
HELP_STARS_B: Plant the same seed on a plant to give it a [b]star[/b] (up to 3). Every star adds damage, health and attack speed. Stars are kept when the glove moves a plant.
HELP_ZOMBIES_B:
Zombies have a [b]tier[/b] (basic, armoured, elite, boss) and a [b]profile[/b]:
- Ground: hit by everything.
- Low (Cardboard Box): straight shots fly over it; use low shots, catapults, thorns or explosions.
- Air (Balloon): flies over most plants. Hit it with anti-air (Spine Cactus), flying plants, wind, bees, freezing or explosions.
Slingshot zombies attack flying plants from a distance.
HELP_LEGENDARY_B: Legendary plants have a golden frame. They are rare rewards from late campaign levels: Aegis Pumpkin, Thunder Root, Sky Dragon, Chrono Clover, Bean Patriarch, Starfall Melon and more. They cost a lot of sun and have a long recharge.
HELP_MODES_B:
[b]Adventure[/b] - 200 levels in 8 worlds with special missions.
[b]Endless Zone[/b] - survive as many waves as possible; your best wave is saved.
[b]Daily Challenge[/b] - a new level with fixed seeds every day, with a bonus reward.
